metadata.title: AI chip stocks were riding high. Here’s why Micron and others are now pulling back. - MarketWatch

content.text:
Tech Stocks
AI chip stocks were riding high. Here’s why Micron and others are now pulling back.
Analysts note high expectations, concerns about elevated Treasury yields and a potential letdown surrounding Anthropic’s financial progress
After staging a comeback recently, chip stocks stalled out on Tuesday as investors weighed economic developments as well as reports of new financial figures from a leading artificial-intelligence company.
Many of the S&P 500’s SPX worst performers Tuesday were semiconductor or optical stocks — with Coherent COHR, Ciena CIEN and Lumentum Holdings LITE pacing the decliners, each down at least 9%. Shares of Sandisk SNDK were off 9% and shares of Micron Technology MU fell 7%.
